subject: Mythology
title: Kaguya-hime: The Moon Princess
description: Learn Kaguya-hime: The Moon Princess in one minute.

hook.text: A bamboo cutter found a glowing baby girl inside a stalk of bamboo. She grew into the most beautiful woman alive.

buildup.text: Five princes sought her hand. She gave each an impossible task. Every single one failed or cheated.

discovery.text: Even the Emperor fell in love with her, but she refused him too, revealing she was not from this world.

twist.text: She came from the moon. When the moon people arrived to take her home, no army could stop them.

climax.text: She left behind an elixir of immortality. The Emperor burned it on Japan's tallest mountain — Mount Fuji.

punchline.text: Mount Fuji got its name because an emperor burned immortality on top of it.

quiz.question: What did the Emperor do with the elixir Kaguya-hime left behind?
options: He drank it and became immortal
He burned it on Japan's tallest mountain, naming it Mount Fuji
He locked it in a shrine for future generations
